query:
select current_timestamp as observed_at,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',attname,'type',format_type(atttypid,atttypmod),'not_null',attnotnull) order by attnum) from pg_attribute where attrelid='public.agreement_messages'::regclass and attnum>0 and not attisdropped) as message_columns,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r,'select',has_table_privilege(r,'public.agreement_messages','SELECT'),'insert',has_table_privilege(r,'public.agreement_messages','INSERT'),'update',has_table_privilege(r,'public.agreement_messages','UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege(r,'public.agreement_messages','DELETE'))) from unnest(array['anon','authenticated','service_role']) r) as message_grants,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',policyname,'roles',roles,'cmd',cmd,'qual',qual,'with_check',with_check)) from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename='agreement_messages') as message_policies,
 (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid=to_regprocedure('public.rpc_send_agreement_message(uuid,text)')) as n01_body_md5,
 to_regprocedure('public.rpc_send_agreement_message_v2(uuid,uuid,text,text)') is null as v2_absent,
 (select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as migrations;
